meta_description: Rex Towing serving Wingate - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Careful towing in Wingate, start to finish.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
cta_h2: Call us and we will come to you
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers motorcycle transport, powersports and small equipment, winch-out and recovery. 147 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.9 out of 5. We work out of Wingate and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.alt: Rex Towing - technician at work on site (photo 6)
services.evidence: Harley-Davidson strapped down on the flatbed with soft ties and a wheel chock

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.alt: Rex Towing - technician at work on site (photo 8)
services.evidence: Rex Towing flatbed on a residential street with a lifted golf cart winched up on the deck

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Rex Towing - technician at work on site (photo 9)
services.evidence: Operator in a hi-vis jacket walking the winch line out across a dark field on a night reco

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Rex Towing - technician at work on site (photo 10)
services.evidence: Red Freightliner flatbed loaded with a pickup, working a call after dark

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.alt: Rex Towing - technician at work on site (photo 5)
services.evidence: Operator in a hi-vis jacket walking the winch line out across a dark field on a night reco

reviews.author: Jade F.
reviews.text: Super fast response, arrived less than 30mins after call.. driver ran into an issue because my car sat so low; however found a solution very fast. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Kelley Ard
reviews.text: I’ve used this service three times now, and every experience has been excellent. They have the best prices around, the driver is always friendly, and they’re consistently on time. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeff Morris
reviews.text: Very pleased. I broke down in my work van in front of customer house and they came quick! The gentleman that towed my car was very nice. I will definitely be keeping there number if I ever need quick tow again for good price.
